remarks: FOR RENT - 637 Cove Road, Stamford, CT 06902 | Unit A15  Welcome to The Beachcomber, located in the beautiful Cove neighborhood of Stamford - one of the area's most sought-after waterfront communities.  This bright and freshly updated 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom apartment offers a clean, modern living space just moments from the shoreline. The unit features a fully updated kitchen with brand new appliances, refinished hardwood floors, and a tastefully updated bathroom. Freshly painted throughout, the apartment has a light and airy feel with great natural sunlight.  Apartment Features: 1 Bedroom / 1 Bathroom Fully updated kitchen with brand new appliances Refinished hardwood floors Updated bathroom Freshly painted interior Bright, sun-filled living space Laundry in building Location Highlights:  Set in Stamford's desirable Cove neighborhood, this location offers the perfect mix of coastal charm and everyday convenience. Enjoy easy access to Cove Beach, where you can take advantage of sandy beaches, walking paths, and beautiful waterfront views.  Additional benefits include:  Close proximity to Downtown Stamford, restaurants, and nightlife Easy access to I-95 and major commuting routes Nearby parks, shopping, and local amenities  A great opportunity to live in a move-in ready apartment in a prime beachside location.
